# A belt cleat: a brick bar across the belt (1.1 x 0.05 x 0.14), origin at its foot. The game
# moves a pool of them with the belt. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Cleat --base-color 0.6588 0.3765 0.3647 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Cleat --size 1 --location 0.000 -0.000 0.025
scale 0.140 1.100 0.050
apply --scale
material assign Cleat
active Cleat
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
shade flat
export cleat.glb
